Title: Gift webhook idempotency hardening
Description: Prevent duplicate gift inserts and duplicate state transitions on Stripe retries by enforcing uniqueness and safe replay handling
Acceptance Criteria: Replaying same webhook event does not change totals; replay test passes on local fixture

Title: Gift state transition guardrails
Description: Enforce valid lifecycle transitions only and block invalid transitions with structured errors
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid transitions are blocked; admin override leaves traceable audit row

Title: Admin integrity card data completeness
Description: Remove empty integrity states and always return deterministic diagnostics structure
Acceptance Criteria: Integrity section always renders with deterministic structure; empty-db case is informative and non-breaking

Title: Funnel instrumentation baseline
Description: Capture first-touch to first-gift event chain with normalized payload contracts
Acceptance Criteria: Sample session shows expected event sequence; admin/growth endpoint reads counts by 7-day window

Title: Checkout validation hard stop (email + inputs)
Description: Prevent avoidable Stripe 400 errors by validating email and required checkout fields before API call
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid email never reaches checkout endpoint; user sees actionable inline error

Title: Mobile CTA crowding pass

Acceptance Criteria: No overlapping/cutoff labels on mobile widths; tap targets meet minimum size expectation

Title: Admin crash guard pass
Description: Add resilient loading and error boundaries per admin tab and prevent hook-order regressions
Acceptance Criteria: No nominal-path tab crashes; error states recover via refresh/retry

Title: Baseline smoke script update
